action.objective: Commit the verified Rxf7 capture, trading rooks into a more solid structure while keeping king safety checked.
action.rationale: Rxf7 is the sole commit_ready move: exact -481 at effective depth 4, safety.complete with mate-in-one and checking-chain probes not_found. It wins the f7 rook; if Black recaptures with Nxf7, White recovers e3f2. Broad search found -487, so this is consistent. Moving the f2 rook also relieves congestion around the king. No proven refutations exist and no better verified alternative is available.
